title: RNA-Seq Data Analysis Using Bowtie, TopHat, and Cufflinks
author: Kiichi Hirota
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x9qfr5w
materials: Total RNA was extracted from cells using RNeasy® Mini Kit (Qiagen).

steps.title: Construct Poly(A) RNA Libraries
steps.instruction: Construct Poly(A) RNA libraries using the TruSeq® Stranded mRNA Library Prep Kit (Illumina).

steps.title: Sequence Libraries
steps.instruction: Sequence the libraries at 100 bp paired-ends on an Illumina HiSeq 2500 platform.

steps.title: Perform Quality Control and Trimming
steps.instruction: Trim the sequencing data using fastx_toolkit and evaluate the quality of the sequence data using FastQC.

steps.title: Download Reference Files
steps.instruction: Download the human reference sequence file (hs37d5.fa) from the 1000 genome ftp site (ftp://ftp.1000genomes.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/ftp/technical/reference/phase2_reference_assembly_sequence/) and the annotated general feature format (gff) file from the Illumina iGenome ftp site (ftp://igenome:G3nom3s4u@ussd-ftp.illumina.com/Homo_sapiens/NCBI/build37.2/).

steps.title: Construct Human Genome Index
steps.instruction: Construct the human genome index using bowtie-build in Bowtie.

steps.title: Align FASTQ Files
steps.instruction: Align the fastq files to the reference genomic sequence using TopHat with default parameters, utilizing Bowtie2 and Samtools within the TopHat program.

steps.title: Estimate Transcript Abundance
steps.instruction: Calculate transcript abundance and normalize count values to the upper quartile of the fragments per kilobase of transcript per million fragments mapped reads (FPKM) using Cufflinks (cuffdiff).

steps.title: Perform Gene Set Enrichment Analysis
steps.instruction: Generate a gene list from the cuffdiff program output and use Metascape for gene set enrichment analysis.

steps.title: Extract and Sort Gene Ontology Annotations
steps.instruction: Extract gene ontology annotations using Ensembl Biomart and sort them by calculated values based on the cuffdiff output file.

substeps.instruction: Add the integer one to all FPKM values to avoid calculating the logarithm of 0.
Calculate values using the formula: common logarithms of ([FPKM of RCC4-EV] + 1)/([FPKM of RCC4-VHL] + 1).

steps.title: Generate Histogram
steps.instruction: Generate the histogram using TIBCO Spotfire Desktop.
